lines.speaker: Guide
lines.text: Welcome to the ruins. Use WASD to move and Space to jump.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Note: Momentum is key. Long jumps require a running start.

lines.speaker: Objective
lines.text: Tutorial Started: Reach the upper ledge.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: Halt! The ruins ahead are unstable.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: You'll need more than just luck to survive the storm.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.text: Great job! You're ready to explore the rest of the ruins.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Figure
lines.text: I see you've made it this far. The storm is just the beginning.

lines.speaker: Mysterious Figure
lines.text: Beware of what lies ahead, for the ruins hold many secrets.

lines.speaker: Done
lines.text: you have completed the advanced quest, proceed to the expert level.

lines.speaker: Hidden Path
lines.text: You've discovered a secret passage. Proceed with caution.
